human_title: SYNTHETIC: Heated bed temperature: reading outside the documented window

hypotheses.label: OFFICIAL_REFERENCE
hypotheses.text: The official page gives -10 to 110 degC as the normal bed range and lists wiring and sensor checks when it is left (official code 0003-0526-0000-0000)

limits: A reading is a fact about the sensor value, not proof of its cause.
Thresholds come from the official wiki; the wiki pages do not always agree.
missing_data: Whether the printer itself displayed the code, and the state of the sensor wiring.
safe_actions: Follow the linked official page; do not bypass safety limits.
